name: nexus_create_or_update_revision
description:
Create a new draft revision or update the existing draft via v2 GraphQL.

Pass mods_json (or the full payload via collection_data_json) to replace
the revision's mod list; omit mods_json to keep it unchanged.

Returns:
    JSON {success, collectionId, revisionId, revisionNumber} or an error string.

adult_content.description: Whether the revision contains adult resources.
adult_content.title: Adult Content

collection_data_json.description: Full CollectionPayload JSON overriding all other params.
collection_data_json.title: Collection Data Json

mods_json.description: JSON array of mods: [{name, version, optional, domainName, source: {...}, author}].
mods_json.title: Mods Json
